Where Innovation Meets Education

California National University (CNU) is built on the belief that education should be accessible, transformative, and tailored to the needs of today’s global learners. As a modern institution rooted in academic excellence and innovation, we are committed to delivering programs that are both flexible and career-oriented. Whether you're a working professional looking to upskill, a high school graduate ready to begin your journey, or someone seeking a fresh start, CNU offers an environment where ambition is nurtured, and success is within reach.

Our programs span across diverse fields—from business and engineering to psychology, health sciences, and beyond—delivered through dynamic online learning platforms and guided by faculty with real-world expertise. Every course is designed to equip you with practical knowledge, critical thinking, and leadership skills necessary for today’s evolving workforce.

Support at Every Step—Resources that Move You Forward

At CNU, student success is at the core of everything we do. Our scholarship opportunities ensure financial barriers never stand in the way of your academic journey. From merit-based awards to need-based aid, we’re committed to helping you pursue your degree with confidence and peace of mind.

We also simplify transitions for students coming from other institutions through flexible credit transfer options. Our support services—available 24/7—ensure you're never alone. Whether it’s academic advising, tech help, or career guidance, CNU stands beside you from day one to graduation.

SCHOLARSHIPS

Explore a range of scholarships designed to reward talent, dedication, and potential—up to 80% available for eligible students.

CREDIT TRANSFER

Maximize your past education with our streamlined credit evaluation process and get closer to your degree faster.

CAREER SERVICES

Enjoy round-the-clock academic, technical, and career support to make your learning experience smooth and successful.

Top Programs Chosen by Our Global Student Community

Bachelor’s in Psychology

Explore the complexities of human behavior, emotional health, and cognitive development. This program prepares students for diverse roles in counseling, human resources, and social services. Build a solid foundation for graduate studies or applied practice.

Enroll Now

Master’s in Finance

Advance your expertise in financial analysis, risk management, and investment strategy. Gain practical insights into global markets, corporate finance, and economic forecasting. Ideal for aspiring CFOs, analysts, and business consultants.

Enroll Now

PhD in Environmental Science

Become a thought leader in sustainability and environmental research. Engage in advanced studies on climate change, ecological systems, and green innovation. Prepare for high-impact roles in policy, academia, and environmental consulting.

Enroll Now

Diploma in Graphic Design

Master industry-standard tools like Adobe Creative Suite while learning principles of visual storytelling and user experience. This diploma is perfect for aspiring designers, marketers, and creative professionals. Turn your artistic vision into a thriving career.

Enroll Now

Certificate in Project Management

Gain essential skills in planning, execution, and team coordination across various industries. Learn to manage timelines, resources, and deliverables efficiently. Perfect for professionals seeking advancement or a career switch.

Enroll Now

Associate Degree in Business Administration

Build a strong foundation in business fundamentals including management, marketing, and operations. This program is ideal for entry-level roles or as a stepping stone to a bachelor's degree. Start your journey toward leadership and entrepreneurship.

Enroll Now

Bachelor’s in Computer Science

Dive into programming, database systems, and artificial intelligence through hands-on projects. Develop software solutions and understand the backbone of digital technology. Graduate with skills in high demand across all industries.

Enroll Now

Master’s in Education Leadership

Shape the future of learning with skills in school management, curriculum design, and policy development. This program is designed for educators aiming to lead with vision and innovation. Empower change at institutional and policy levels.

Enroll Now

Certificate in Cybersecurity

Protect digital systems from cyber threats through practical training in ethical hacking, risk assessment, and data protection. Stay ahead in a fast-evolving tech world. Perfect for IT professionals or career shifters entering cybersecurity.

Enroll Now

Diploma in Early Childhood Education

Learn child development theories, curriculum planning, and classroom management techniques. Prepare for rewarding careers in preschools, daycare centers, or early education programs. Make a lasting difference in a child’s formative years.

Enroll Now
